Milton Keynes Council CMK Handbook F10 Fixed Bollards: 1000 mm high, 100 mm diameter. Not a Manchester survey; typical UK highway fixed-bollard spec. Current scene already uses 1.0 m height.

2018 Ford Focus 5-door (Ford EU media tech specs): overall length 4378 mm, height including antenna 1471 mm, width without mirrors 1825 mm. The Kenney sedan is a toy-style stand-in, scaled so its length matches this common UK family-hatch size. Not a survey of cars that park on Whitworth St W.
